en_us.tooltip.hbm.holotape.label: Label:
en_us.tooltip.hbm.polaroid.5: If you stare long into the abyss, the abyss stares back.
en_us.holotape.hbm.holo_digamma.text: The tape contains a music track that has degraded heavily in quality, making it near-impossible to make out what it once was. There is an image file on it that has also lost its quality, being reduced to a blur of crimson and cream colors. The disk has small shreds of greasy wrapping paper stuck to it.
en_us.holotape.hbm.holo_restored.text: The tape contains a music track that you do not recognize, consisting of mostly electric guitars with lyrics telling the story of a man being left by someone who is moving to another city. The tape also contains an image file, the crimson and cream colors sharp on an otherwise colorless background. You try to look closer but you can't. It feels as if reality itself is twisted and stretched and snapped back into shape like a rubber band.
en_us.holotape.hbm.holo_fe_hall.text: The tape contains an audio track that is mostly gabled sound and garbage noise. There is an image file on it, depicting a small hall with a fountain in the center, a metal door to the left and an open wooden door to the right, with faint green light coming through the doorway. On the left wall of the room, there is a wooden bench with a skeleton sitting on it.
en_us.holotape.hbm.holo_fe_corridor.text: The tape contains an audio track that is mostly gabled sound and garbage noise. There is an image file on it, depicting a short hallway with a terminal screen mounted to the right wall, bathing the corridor in a phosphorus-green light. In front of the terminal, an unusually large skeleton is piled up on the floor. On the back of the hallway there's a sturdy metal door standing open.
en_us.holotape.hbm.holo_fe_server.text: The tape contains an audio track that is mostly gabled sound and garbage noise. There is an image file on it, depicting what appears to be a server room with racks covering every wall. In the center, what appears to be some sort of super computer is standing tall, with wires coming out from it, going in every direction. On the right side of the room, a small brass trapdoor stands open where one of the wall racks would be.
en_us.holotape.hbm.holo_feh_dome.text: The tape contains an audio track that is mostly gabled sound and garbage noise. There is an image file on it, depicting the insides of a large dome-like concrete structure that is mostly empty, save for a few catwalks and a shiny blueish metal capsule suspended in the center. In the background, the faint outline of what appears to be a tank is visible, sporting mechanical legs instead of treads.
en_us.holotape.hbm.holo_feh_boat.text: The tape contains an audio track that is mostly gabled sound and garbage noise. There is an image file on it, depicting the wooden deck of what appears to be an old river boat. There are four rusted railway spikes stuck in the planks in a roughly square shape.
en_us.holotape.hbm.holo_feh_lsc.text: The tape contains an audio track that is mostly gabled sound and garbage noise. There is an image file on it, depicting an array of launch pads surrounded by large metal bulwarks. Two of the launch pads are empty, the remaining rockets seem to be heavily damaged. A tipped-over booster is visible, creating plumes of fog.
en_us.holotape.hbm.holo_f3_rc.text: The tape contains an audio track that is mostly gabled sound and garbage noise. There is an image file on it, depicting an old aircraft carrier that has broken in two. A makeshift bridge held up by the ship's crane connects the tower with a small building on the shore.
en_us.holotape.hbm.holo_f3_iv.text: The tape contains an audio track that is mostly gabled sound and garbage noise. There is a very grainy image file on it, depicting what appears to be a crater with a small tunnel leading into the ground at the very bottom, closed off with a small wooden door.
en_us.holotape.hbm.holo_f3_wm.text: The tape contains an audio track that is mostly gabled sound and garbage noise. There is an image file on it, depicting a large white obelisk that seems half destroyed. At the top there is a radio dish sticking out of the structure.
en_us.holotape.hbm.holo_nv_crater.text: The tape contains an audio track that is mostly gabled sound and garbage noise. There is an image file on it, depicting a large dome in blue light surrounded by many smaller buildings. In the distance, there is a smaller dome with red lights.
en_us.holotape.hbm.holo_nv_divide.text: The tape contains an audio track that is mostly gabled sound and garbage noise. There is an image file on it, depicting a large chasm with broken highways and destroyed buildings littering the landscape.
en_us.holotape.hbm.holo_nv_bm.text: The tape contains an audio track that is mostly gabled sound and garbage noise. There is an image file on it, depicting a satellite broadcasting station on top of a hill. In the distance, there is a very large person walking hand in hand with a robot into the sunset.
en_us.holotape.hbm.holo_o_2.text: The tape contains a news article, reporting an unusually pale person throwing flashbangs at people in public. The image at the bottom shows one of the incidents, unsurprisingly the light from one of the flashbangs made it unrecognizable.
en_us.holotape.hbm.holo_o_3.text: The tape contains an article from a science fiction magazine, engaging with various reader comments about what to do with a time machine. One of those comments suggests engaging in various unsanitary acts with the future self, being signed off with just the initial '~D'.
en_us.holotape.hbm.holo_challenge.text: An empty holotape. The back has the following message scribbled on it with black marker: "official challenge - convince me that lyons' brotherhood isn't the best brotherhood of steel chapter and win a custom cape!" The tape smells like chicken nuggets.

zh_cn.item.polaroid.name: 偏光片
zh_cn.item.holotape_image.name: 全息卡带
zh_cn.tooltip.hbm.holotape.label: 标签：
zh_cn.tooltip.hbm.polaroid.5: 凝视深渊过久，深渊也将回以凝视。
zh_cn.holotape.hbm.holo_digamma.text: 卡带里有一首音质严重劣化的乐曲，几乎无法辨认它原本的样子。里面还有一个同样失去画质的图像文件，只剩下模糊的绯红色与奶油色。卡带上粘着几片油腻的包装纸。
zh_cn.holotape.hbm.holo_restored.text: 卡带里有一首你不认识的乐曲，主要由电吉他伴奏，歌词讲述了一个人被即将搬往另一座城市的人离开的故事。卡带中还有一个图像文件：在其余部分没有颜色的背景上，绯红与奶油色清晰可见。你想看得更近一些，却做不到。仿佛现实本身像橡皮筋一样被扭曲、拉伸，然后猛地弹回原状。
zh_cn.holotape.hbm.holo_fe_hall.text: 卡带里的音轨大多是含混的声音和杂乱的噪声。图像文件显示一座小厅，中央有一座喷泉，左侧是一扇金属门，右侧敞开的木门里透出微弱的绿光。房间左侧墙边有一张木长椅，上面坐着一具骷髅。
zh_cn.holotape.hbm.holo_fe_corridor.text: 卡带里的音轨大多是含混的声音和杂乱的噪声。图像文件显示一条短走廊，右侧墙上的终端屏幕让整条走廊沐浴在磷光般的绿光中。终端前的地板上堆着一具异常巨大的骷髅，走廊尽头的一扇坚固金属门敞开着。
zh_cn.holotape.hbm.holo_fe_server.text: 卡带里的音轨大多是含混的声音和杂乱的噪声。图像文件似乎显示一间服务器机房，四周墙边都摆满机架。中央矗立着某种超级计算机，电缆从中伸出，通往四面八方。房间右侧原本应是墙边机架的位置，敞开着一扇黄铜小活板门。
zh_cn.holotape.hbm.holo_feh_dome.text: 卡带里的音轨大多是含混的声音和杂乱的噪声。图像文件显示一座巨大的混凝土穹顶内部，里面几乎空无一物，只有几条栈道和中央悬挂着的闪亮蓝色金属舱。背景中依稀可见某种坦克的轮廓，它用机械腿代替了履带。
zh_cn.holotape.hbm.holo_feh_boat.text: 卡带里的音轨大多是含混的声音和杂乱的噪声。图像文件显示一艘似乎是古老河船的木制甲板，四根锈蚀的铁路道钉钉在木板上，围成近似正方形。
zh_cn.holotape.hbm.holo_feh_lsc.text: 卡带里的音轨大多是含混的声音和杂乱的噪声。图像文件显示一片被巨大金属壁垒包围的发射台。两座发射台空着，其余火箭似乎都已严重受损。一个翻倒的助推器正在喷出团团雾气。
zh_cn.holotape.hbm.holo_f3_rc.text: 卡带里的音轨大多是含混的声音和杂乱的噪声。图像文件显示一艘断成两截的旧航空母舰，一座由船上起重机支撑的临时桥梁，将舰桥与岸边的一座小建筑连接起来。
zh_cn.holotape.hbm.holo_f3_iv.text: 卡带里的音轨大多是含混的声音和杂乱的噪声。一个颗粒非常粗糙的图像文件似乎显示了一座陨坑，坑底有一条通往地下的小隧道，入口被一扇木制小门封住。
zh_cn.holotape.hbm.holo_f3_wm.text: 卡带里的音轨大多是含混的声音和杂乱的噪声。图像文件显示一座似乎被毁去一半的巨大白色方尖碑，结构顶部伸出一面无线电天线。
zh_cn.holotape.hbm.holo_nv_crater.text: 卡带里的音轨大多是含混的声音和杂乱的噪声。图像文件显示一座沐浴在蓝光中的巨大穹顶，周围环绕着许多较小的建筑。远处还有一座亮着红灯的小穹顶。
zh_cn.holotape.hbm.holo_nv_divide.text: 卡带里的音轨大多是含混的声音和杂乱的噪声。图像文件显示一条巨大的裂谷，四周散落着断裂的高速公路与被毁的建筑。
zh_cn.holotape.hbm.holo_nv_bm.text: 卡带里的音轨大多是含混的声音和杂乱的噪声。图像文件显示一座位于山顶的卫星广播站。远处，一个身形异常高大的人正与一台机器人手牵着手，走向夕阳。
zh_cn.holotape.hbm.holo_o_2.text: 卡带中有一篇新闻报道，讲述一名肤色异常苍白的人在公共场所向别人投掷闪光弹。报道末尾的图片拍下了其中一次事件；毫不意外，闪光弹的强光使画面无法辨认。
zh_cn.holotape.hbm.holo_o_3.text: 卡带中有一篇科幻杂志文章，讨论读者们对于如何使用时间机器的各种评论。其中一条建议对未来的自己做出各种不卫生的行为，署名只有一个“~D”。
zh_cn.holotape.hbm.holo_challenge.text: 一盘空白的全息卡带。背面有人用黑色记号笔潦草地写着：“官方挑战——说服我里昂的兄弟会并非最棒的钢铁兄弟会分部，即可赢得一件定制披风！”卡带闻起来像鸡块。
